checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity (tb-005): Data column sidecar publishing MUST only occur on subnets the node is subscribed to (via custody or sampling duties)?

reachability.notes: Publishing to non-subscribed subnets is unauthorized.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Identify all code paths that could affect the invariant at boundary tb-005. 2. Review the implementation to verify: Data column sidecar publishing MUST only occur on subnets the node is subscribed to (via custody or sampling duties). Non-subscribed subnets MUST NOT receive published sidecars from this node. 3. Attempt to craft inputs via P2P that would violate this invariant. 4. Test edge cases at boundary conditions (epoch transitions, maximum values, empty inputs). 5. Verify that violations are detected and handled before crossing the trust boundary. 6. Check for race conditions or TOCTOU issues at the boundary.
